scores.reasoning: The Real Question is dual: (a) what is the AI-native architecture that makes international travel feel effortless, and (b) is this the right bet now? The central thesis 'algorithm gap not feature gap, a ranking layer not a chatbot' maps directly to (a); s7/s12 answer (b) with an explicit fund-now call tied to GMV mix-shift and market timing. The draft resists the intent's named trap (NOT 'build 10 features') and delivers a product paradigm, mirroring the intent's recommendation frame stage-for-stage. The primary 'not a chatbot' gate is directly and repeatedly answered with the ranking-layer bet, and the draft honestly flags that Ixigo's own shipped AI is conversational rather than over-reading the earnings quote. Exact match to the real question, not a related one.

All 9 success criteria covered (9/9), each at argued depth rather than mention-level: journey stages each get a specific mechanism, algorithm section names three components and separates ML from rules-based, metrics span all three required dimensions plus monitoring, rollout has genuine staffing/technical rationale. Senior-PM depth requirement met. The one lighter spot is C9 (funnel diff): it is handled as reasoned inference plus a recommended pre-build UX audit rather than a concrete step-by-step side-by-side of Ixigo's actual domestic vs international funnels. This is transparently owned and registered (A4), but it is genuinely thinner than the other eight criteria, which caps a perfect score.

Cross-checked 6 specific claims against research. (1) MMT-Atlys exclusive-leaning, 2-3mo head start -> Q6 Finding 3 confirms. (2) $23-35B/11.4% CAGR -> Q5 Findings 1-2 confirm. (3) Airbnb ranking drives majority of conversions -> Q3 Finding 3 (KDD '99% of conversions'); draft softens to 'large/substantial majority' appropriately. (4) Booking.com ~150 ML models under chat UI -> Q3 Finding 6, flagged company-disclosed; draft carries same caveat. (5) Thailand visa-free removal May 19 2026 + 2.13-2.5M Bangkok -> Q2 Finding 5 + Q5 Finding 4 confirm. (6) Ixigo shipped AI is conversational, no product-layer ranking evidence -> Q4 confirms; draft flags ~0.6 confidence absence-of-evidence. GMV multiplier explicitly labeled ungrounded estimate (A7), not claimed as research fact. Draft does NOT overclaim Atlys exclusivity (Q6 notes MMT is investor not exclusive partner) and instead frames exclusivity as a risk with fallbacks. 6/6 verified claims grounded; estimates correctly flagged.

Clears the rubric's 'wrong by design not feature gap' bar. Core insights carry non-obvious second-order implications: (1) MMT's visa/forex features reframed as evidence of the pain point to convert into ranking signals, not features to copy; (2) low CAC named and rejected as the wrong business argument in favor of GMV mix-shift (senior opportunity-cost reasoning); (3) two-track rollout defended as different-in-kind by skill set, pre-empting the 'relabeled sequential work' critique; (4) the Booking.com 'chat gets the press, ranking gets the investment' contrast used to justify the architectural bet rather than merely cited. Each major section converts fact into 'so what'; minimal pure data restatement.

No contradictions found.
